definition-dropped.answer: The word is 'this type of PERFORM statement' (a kind of statement), not §2002:4 4.182 type (for type declaration); the definition cannot change the rule's scope.

pending-clause.answer: Triggered by the same word 'type'; GR6 involves no typedef, zero-length item or alignment, so it does not rest on §2002:8.5.3, 8.5.4 or 14.5.8.

band-formats.answer: The 2002 PERFORM has two formats, out-of-line and inline (§2002:14.8.27.1), with one unbanded syntax-rule list; they are 2023 formats 1 and 2 phrase for phrase (2023 adds UNTIL EXIT and format 3, both absent from 2002). The 2023 band FORMATS 1 AND 2 therefore reaches every 2002 PERFORM; no 2002 format falls outside it. GR6 defines the basic PERFORM in either format.
